verifications.claim: Seven ties have been officially recorded at the Oscars.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'whopping seven ties'; R2: 'happened six times before' (plus 2026); R3: 'only the seventh tie ever'
verifications.reasoning: All sources explicitly state or imply exactly seven ties including the 2026 event.

verifications.claim: The Academy Awards have nearly 100 years of history.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: Direct phrasing in two sources confirms the claim precisely.

verifications.claim: The most recent tie at the Oscars occurred at the 2026 ceremony.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'latest taking place... at the 2026 Oscars'; R2: '2026... last tie before 2026 was in 2013'; R3: 'most recent Oscar tie was in 2013' before 2026
verifications.reasoning: All sources identify 2026 as the most recent tie, with prior ones in 2013 or earlier.

verifications.claim: Ties at the Oscars require exact vote matches.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'March technically beat out Beery by one vote... forced the Academy to change its rules'; R2: 'rules have since been changed so that only an exact tie will count'; R3: 'not a true tie... rule has since been changed'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm current rules require exact ties, changed after 1932 near-tie.

verifications.claim: Ties at the Oscars occur primarily in short-film, documentary, or technical categories.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Lists show 5/7 ties in doc short (1950), doc feature (1987), live-action short (1995, 2026), sound editing (2013); only 2 in acting (1932, 1969)
verifications.reasoning: Reference lists directly support the distribution, with majority (5 of 7) in specified categories.

verifications.claim: Acting awards at the Oscars have tied in the past.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Fredric March and Wallace Beery for Best Actor, 1932'; 'Katharine Hepburn and Barbra Streisand for Best Actress, 1969'; R2/R3 similar
verifications.reasoning: All sources explicitly list Best Actor (1932) and Best Actress (1969) ties.

verifications.claim: Major awards at the Oscars have tied in the past.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1/R2/R3: Ties in Best Actor (1932), Best Actress (1969), described as significant historical events
verifications.reasoning: Acting categories (Best Actor/Actress) are standardly considered major awards, explicitly listed in all sources.
